topics.label: Nouns and noun phrases: plurals (regular, -es, -ies, -ves, irregular), collective and uncountable nouns
Determiners: a/an, this/that/these/those, some/any
Verbs and verb phrases: simple present, simple past (regular/irregular), present continuous
Subject-verb agreement: is/are, has/have, verb -s
Pronouns: subject, object and possessive
Adjectives (incl. -er/-est) and -ly adverbs
Prepositions of place and time
Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, so
Punctuation: capitals, full stops, question and exclamation marks, commas in lists
Sentence types: statement, question, command, exclamation
Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms, context, word groups, compound words, contractions
Spelling (incl. common homophones) and editing for grammar (recognition only)
Word order and sequencing events
Connectors, sensory details and showing feelings (selection, not free writing)
Short-passage comprehension: details, sequence, vocabulary in context, feelings, simple inference
Grammar cloze passages
Vocabulary cloze passages
Visual text comprehension: posters, menus, notices
Tenses: past continuous, future with will, irregular past, tense consistency
Subject-verb agreement: each/everyone/neither, there is/are, intervening phrases
Reflexive pronouns and relative pronouns who/which/whose
Prepositions of movement and fixed preposition phrases
Conjunctions: although, when/while/before/after, if/unless
Comparatives/superlatives (more/most, irregular), quantifiers, adverbs of frequency
Apostrophes for possession, speech marks, commas after clauses
Vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms, context, phrasal verbs, word forms, simple idioms
Editing for spelling, grammar and homophones (recognition only)
Sentence combining with because/so, although, who/which, before/after, either/neither
Passage comprehension: details, reasons, inference, character traits, main message
Grammar cloze passages
Comprehension cloze passages (no helping words in school papers; options used in app)
Visual text comprehension: leaflets and notices
Reading aloud and picture/stimulus-based conversation
topics.note: Oral practice stays outside the app.

topics.label: Guided composition (3-picture series, at least 80-100 words)
topics.note: Full writing stays outside the app.

topics.label: Listening comprehension
topics.note: Listening is deferred in the Pilot.

limitations: The per-year grammar and vocabulary list is a working inventory drawn from school documents and papers; the MOE syllabus gives progressing capabilities and lower/middle primary bands, not an official per-year checklist.
Leaves are an author working map (one per repair target plus partial/external/deferred leaves) and need independent verification before any coverage figure is computed.
Choice-based editing, spelling and synthesis are narrower than independent production; production leaves are marked partial.
Reading materials are a starting sample of genres; they do not cover every reading genre or multimodal feature.
Oral and composition are external; listening is deferred.
